title: The Big Fat Christmas Copyright Quiz Is Back!
content:
Were you paying attention this year? Do you remember who was Chancellor before John Healey? Do you know who scored the most goals during the World Cup? Do you remember what won Best Film at the Oscars?

If you know the answer to any of those sensible questions, you will be out of luck. But if you know random facts about Dolly Parton, David Attenborough, Australian animals and of course the copyright controversies of 2026, then come and take part in the Big Fat Christmas Copyright Quiz 2026.

Get your thinking caps or Santa hats on, heat up a mince pie and pour yourself a large mulled wine cup of tea or coffee and join your Christmas elves – Jane Secker and Chris Morrison – and your quiz setter – TV’s own Kathryn Drumm. (Yes, we’re still milking the fact that she was on Only Connect in 2021) for some quirky questions, festive fun and very possibly Morrison’s musical stylings.

All the details

Join us on Friday 18th December at 11am.

Sign up via the ALT events page.
